evidence_limit: These bounded trials neither prove nor disprove ordinary-wall UNSAT and do not establish a full-row speedup. Tiny controls certify only runner/verifier semantics, not wall cases.

recommendation.cross_check: Kissat 4.0.4 with the same input bytes, seed, cap and proof logging.
recommendation.encoding: Use the audited color extension for structured branch work, not as a claimed full-row accelerator. No vertex projection was tested or recommended.
recommendation.lead: CaDiCaL 2.1.2 on exact exported CNFs, seed 0, binary DRAT enabled; use caps for diagnosis and replay every terminal UNSAT.
recommendation.next: An exhaustive physical-pivot/exact-minimum/above-minimum split with independently checked leaf proofs and a composed parent proof is the next meaningful gate; another capped full-row status cannot close the wall.
recommendation.not_default: CaDiCaL 1.9.5 --reduceglucose: no ordinary-wall completion here or in its supplied 40,000-conflict panel, hence no evidence to prefer that modified policy.

selection: Frozen panel row 0 plus audited unequal-minimum representative gap2; both original and full color exports; seed 0; four supplied engines; fixed caps fixed before each stage.
